description: This file contains the implementation of a mock storage provider class used for testing Orleans grain storage functionalities, along with extension methods to add and configure this provider within a silo builder. It defines auxiliary classes for test state and command handling, and includes methods for state management and control commands.

classes.name: MockStorageProvider
classes.description: A mock implementation of a grain storage provider for testing purposes, capable of simulating state read/write operations, control commands, and maintaining test-related counters.

methods.name: AddTestStorageProvider
methods.description: Extension method to add the mock storage provider to an ISiloBuilder with optional custom creation logic.

methods.name: GetProviderState
methods.description: Returns the current internal counters related to provider usage.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a specific value into the mock provider's stored state for a grain.

methods.name: GetLastState
methods.description: Retrieves the last stored state or object, enabling assertions in tests.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Simulates closing the provider, resets counters and clears internal state.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Simulates reading grain state asynchronously, updating the grain state object.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes internal control commands such as initializing counters, setting values, resetting state, etc.
